gemini.title: Uv101b Usual Resident Population By Sex By Age Oa
gemini.abstract: Uv101b Usual Resident Population By Sex By Age Oa is an authoritative dataset published by National Records of Scotland. It contains records relating to uv101b usual resident population by sex by age oa.
gemini.lineage: Published by National Records of Scotland as open statistics and boundary data. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.
